messages:
maria: quick check — onboarding run for 'zephyr-3b' failed on the serving smoke. CI lint flagged tokenizer.eos_token_id out-of-range vs vocab_size. weights path in the PR points to s3://redwood-onboard/zephyr-3b/v1/weights.bin. @eli can you confirm that is the canonical weights location and whether the service account has read access? pinging @nina for tokenizer QA.

eli: I checked S3 — path exists, size ~4.2GB, sha256=abc123def4567890. I granted read to redwood-onboard-prod. If you need a presigned link I can generate one.

nina: CI log snippet: `tokenizer.vocab_size=50265` but `eos_token_id=50265` -> index OOB (max valid = 50264). That will crash during tokenization -> model.forward. Looks like they appended special tokens after export. Do we want to patch the tokenizer config or update the vocab itself?

toby: model team confirms they appended two special tokens after export (serialized with special_tokens_map = {'<s>':50265, '</s>':50266}). They did not increment vocab_size.

sam: my 2c: avoid re-exporting weights if possible. Patch config.json to include the new special token ids and bump `vocab_size` to 50267. Also add a short-circuit flag for serving schema: `allow_out_of_vocab_specials: true` so older checks don't block canary deploys.

maria: prefer config patch too. can someone propose the exact minimal change? nina, can you run a local smoke with a patched config? here's the snippet i suggest: 

```json
{
  "model_name": "zephyr-3b",
  "weights": "s3://redwood-onboard/zephyr-3b/v1/weights.bin",
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "hf",
    "vocab_size": 50267,
    "special_tokens": {
      "bos_token_id": 50265,
      "eos_token_id": 50266
    },
    "padding_side": "right"
  },
  "serving": {
    "quantize": "q4_0",
    "compatibility": {"allow_out_of_vocab_specials": true}
  }
}
```

nina: running local smoke with that patched config now. small aside: CI also showed `padding_side` mismatch (tokenizer had left vs model expects right). when padding_side=right, ensure `pad_token_id` exists. i'll check both. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

config-lint-bot: ERROR: config-lint failed — missing required field `tokenizer.special_tokens` (schema v2). See https://confluence/redwood/config-schema for migration notes.

eli: presigned link generated: https://s3.redwood.example/zephyr-3b/v1/weights.bin?X-Amz-Signature=XXX (valid 1h). sharing in case someone needs direct download.

toby: i'll open a tiny PR to update config.json and add a note in onboard/README about special tokens and the schema flag. branch: onboard/zephyr-3b-config-fix. tagging @sam for review.

sam: will review ~30m. for rollout plan: create a canary route with `allow_out_of_vocab_specials=true` and monitor tokenization error rates and latency for a day before full swap. if anything weird, auto-fallback to previous model.

maria: perfect. nina — can you post the smoke logs here when done? if CI passes we can merge the config patch.

nina: smoke run done — patched config + presigned weights worked. tokenizer no longer OOB, pad_token_id present, local serve completed generation test. re-ran config-lint after adding `special_tokens` and `vocab_size` -> linter green. PR LGTM from my side. :tada:

maria: excellent, thanks everyone. i'll merge once sam approves the PR. dropping a follow-up note in the onboard checklist to remind owners to update `vocab_size` whenever appending special tokens.

sam: acked. will do quick review now.

maria: if anything else crops up (weird token decoding, alignment issues), continue in this thread. thanks all. :pray:
